title: "50 grams of powder"
situation: A clip purports to show a Mumbai officer warning detained students that if they protest again he will plant drugs on them so they never get bail. An inquiry is ordered.

lines.text: There is no one worse than me. You people are causing trouble for us.
lines.speaker: officer (alleged)

quoted.text: Raising one's voice is not a crime.
quoted.speaker: Congress

buildThis.situation: Tone reference for a bullying constable in the detention bus; not a comic beat.

doNotInfer: authenticity of the clip (inquiry pending at publication)
